title: monardella linoides subsp. stricta
intro: Monardella linoides subsp. stricta, commonly known as Purple Needlegrass Monardella or Purple Foothill Monardella, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae) that is native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. The health benefits of this plant include its potential use as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent, which may help reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Monardella linoides subsp. stricta include its ability to act as a diaphoretic, helping to induce sweating and promote the release of toxins from the body, as well as its use as a mild sedative to calm the nervous system. Bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
